step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a modified CMOS inverter where the NMOS source is connected to a control voltage (V_CONTROL) instead of ground. This configuration allows tuning of the discharge current, thereby controlling the high-to-low propagation delay, which is useful in delay-locked loops (DLLs) and waveform converters.

paper_reference.title: A VLSI CMOS Delay Oriented Waveform Converter for Polyphase Frequency Synthesizer

t_delay_fall.description: High-to-low propagation delay from input to output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay is dominated by the discharge of the output capacitance through the NMOS. With V_CONTROL > 0, Vgs of NMOS is reduced and Vds is reduced, decreasing the discharge current. Assuming Cload ~ 10fF, I_discharge ~ 100uA, delay ~ (Cload * VDD/2) / I_discharge.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V process. The delay will heavily depend on the V_CONTROL voltage and output load.

t_delay_rise.description: Low-to-high propagation delay from input to output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the PMOS charging the output node. PMOS source is at VDD, so it operates as a standard inverter pull-up.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard PMOS pull-up delay in SKY130 for a 5um/0.5um device driving a small load.

power_consumption.description: Average dynamic power consumption of the cell.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C_load * VDD * V_swing * f. For a single cell at 250MHz with 10fF load and 1.8V supply.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 50mW reported in the paper is for the entire multi-stage waveform converter and frequency multiplier. A single cell will consume significantly less power.

switching_threshold.description: Input voltage at which the output transitions (typically where VOUT crosses VDD/2).

sky130_expected.calculation: Intersection of PMOS and NMOS current curves. Since NMOS source is at V_CONTROL, the effective Vgs is VIN - V_CONTROL, shifting the threshold higher.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With V_CONTROL > 0, the NMOS is weaker, pushing the switching threshold above VDD/2 (0.9V).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure propagation delays, power consumption, and DC switching threshold of the voltage-controlled delay cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Voltage-Controlled Delay Cell

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 VOUT VIN V_CONTROL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VOUT VIN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVCTRL V_CONTROL 0 0.3
* 250 MHz Pulse input
VVIN VIN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 1.9n 4n)

* Load capacitance
Cload VOUT 0 10f

.control
  * 1. Transient Analysis for Delay and Power
  tran 10p 20n
  
  * Measure delays at 50% of VDD (0.9V)
  meas tran t_delay_fall trig v(VIN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(VOUT) val=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran t_delay_rise trig v(VIN) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(VOUT) val=0.9 rise=1
  
  * Measure average power consumption
  meas tran avg_current_vdd avg i(VVDD) from=0 to=20n
  let avg_power = -avg_current_vdd * 1.8
  print avg_power
  
  * 2. DC Analysis for Switching Threshold
  dc VVIN 0 1.8 0.01
  * Measure threshold when output crosses 1.0V (approximate midpoint considering V_CONTROL=0.3V)
  meas dc v_threshold when v(VOUT)=1.0 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
